answer: Private task variants: each epoch the ledger hands every identity its own sealed twist on the challenge, such as a different constraint or data set derived from its address, so no two accounts get the same kernel to work on. A farm can no longer write one answer and paraphrase it a thousand ways; like water carving karst, every fake must wear down its own problem from scratch. Over a long horizon that makes each sybil cost a full agent's compute per epoch, wiping out the scale advantage.
